doc.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Fantasy albums and Todd Barkin
summary: He says Barkin and Fantasy did not respect his ability.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Then you have this long – or at least three- or four-, five-years period where you get a recording contract with Fantasy and you do these albums produced by . . .
Tell us about those albums and . . .
Todd was skunky too. He was one of them skunks that they didn’t want to do right and you were supposed to accept it, because they were who they were.
Because – but your feeling about that was that they didn’t give you the artistic freedom, they didn’t let you pick the . . .
They didn’t respect your ability. Everything turned out to be nothing.
